reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I forget pills on the counter and live out of my tote, so one sachet in the bag fixes my real problem. $29.99 is a stretch on my budget, so I would try one box and not subscribe.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? $30 is a lot for me to spend on something that might do nothing, and I can get plain magnesium at the drugstore for much less.
would_change_my_mind: A lower first-box price (around $20) or a smaller trial pack, so I can find out if it helps my sleep before paying for 30 days.
